strengths: All interactive controls meet the 44px touch target minimum — pause/play, music, menu, chronicle links, delete confirm, chronicle tabs all verified in CSS.
The pace pulse-dot (`.flow::before` breathing animation, faster amber in hurry, still when paused) gives a clear at-a-glance liveness signal without cluttering the screen.
Fast-forward by tapping the flow text is exactly the right gesture for a casual player who wants to race through a quiet stretch — discoverable because the text is a button.
Cold-start confirmation toast ('Continuing House X — 2nd of the line, age 34') means a player picking up mid-session always knows where they are within seconds.
Choice hints auto-reveal on touch devices (`@media (hover:none)`) so the secondary context appears without needing hover — the mobile player gets the full card.
The `viewport-fit=cover` + `safe-area-inset-bottom` footer padding handles notched phones cleanly.
The reflect button ('how things stand') has a visible border now, making it discoverable as a tappable affordance rather than bare text.
The save code textarea is 13px with `user-select:all` — one-tap copy works on mobile without fiddly drag-selection.
Ephemeral log entries with auto-fade keep the screen uncluttered between moments — important for one-handed reading.

The dynasty content tuning (epitaph anti-repetition, reputation rebalancing, motto crystallization) means a multi-generation run stays fresh, rewarding the player who comes back across short sessions.

improvements.what: Add a subtle scroll-shadow or chevron at the bottom of the stage area when a 3-choice card overflows the viewport height.
improvements.why: `.stage{overflow-y:auto}` handles it mechanically but gives no visual cue that content is cut off below the fold. A casual player on a short phone may not know to scroll and will miss a choice.

improvements.what: Show the log-tap hint slightly earlier — after the very first choice rather than the second — and make it slightly brighter (class `hint` rather than `whisper`) so it competes with the ambient prose.
improvements.why: The chronicle is one of the game's best features, but the log-tap onboarding hint arrives after 2 decisions, by which point a casual short-burst player may have already put the phone down.

improvements.what: In the load menu, move the 'Sync & copy code' button above the slot list (or add a quick-copy icon to each slot row), so the backup flow is reachable without scrolling past all saved slots.
improvements.why: On a short phone with 3+ saves, the backup textarea is below the fold even with the sticky dismiss. A casual player who wants to move to a new device may not find it in a quick session.

verdict: The mobile experience is genuinely solid — every touch target, liveness cue, and one-handed convenience feature from the last round is confirmed intact, and the dynasty content improvements make returning across short sessions more rewarding; no regressions, score holds at 8.4.
